selector.why: The presence of a painful, erosive lesion around the stoma with suprabasal epidermal splitting and acantholysis, along with intercellular deposition of IgG and C3, and high levels of autoantibodies against desmoglein 1 and 3, specifically points towards a localized form of pemphigus vulgaris, given the lack of additional cutaneous or mucosal lesions.
